correctness.rationale: The proof identifies the independence-set flip metric with Hamming distance and provides three exhaustive cases of explicit shortest geodesics through an arbitrary third-class edge for each eligible pair. When a pair belongs to a triangle, the empty/singleton edge of its common neighbor is provably addable. No use of finite enumeration for the infinite assertion. The attached independent direct-BFS checker passed all graphs on 2–5 vertices and 160 seeded order-6 profiles.

Priority remains provisional; latent equivalence to a broader median-graph result is a stated residual risk.

value.rationale: For arbitrary graph hosts, a global edge-geodesic maximality property in an exponentially large independent-set reconfiguration graph is reduced to the local condition that an original edge lies in no triangle. This provides an exact classification and natural count for every pair of coordinate directions, with sharp failure witnesses whenever triangles exist; it does not pretend to classify all maximal edge sets or solve the maximum cardinality problem.
